svg.text: claudia — styling suite 2.1: Edit this style… on a cell
Proposal for review. Shift+F10 at the active cell; the same popover as for a paragraph, with all the facets a cell reads, and where the look comes from.
A · The popover on a selection of Input cells
All three facets of a cell; the line at the top says where the look comes from.
Input — these cells' own style, box and words
Under it: column D is Note; the sheet is Body text
B · After “these cells only” + “only their box”
A box-only deviation: the words keep Input, the box gets a style of its own.
Words Input — the two slots now differ
The line at the top says which style the cells have and where it comes from — their own range, or the row, column or sheet beneath (D307) — and, once the slots differ, both styles.
A cell reads all three facets, so all three sections show; vertical alignment and wrapping are the two Box properties only a cell has (CSS_VERSION 3).
“These cells only” makes one new style for the selection (deviate, D75); “only their box” narrows it to the box slot (D309), so their words keep Input and the change cannot spread to how the numbers
The new style waits for a name, as everywhere (“to name”); naming it is Rename / Name it in All styles, as agreed.
